In detail

Marienfelde Nord is one of Berlin's 143 official Bezirksregionen, part of the Bezirk of Tempelhof-Schöneberg. Polizei Berlin's 2025 Kriminalitätsatlas records a Häufigkeitszahl (HZ) of 5,990 here — total recorded offences per 100,000 registered residents — with 1,075 cases recorded for the year, roughly 0.6× the citywide average, below it. HZ is calculated against registered residents, not footfall, so a busy shopping, transit or tourist area can show a higher HZ without that meaning it is unusually risky to walk through, and a quiet residential zone can show a low HZ simply by having few offences relative to its population. This is Wandroz's only rating layer for Berlin so far — a real official police statistic, not a qualitative or press-based judgment — and the source data does not distinguish day from night, so both figures shown here are the same.

Frequently asked questions

Is Marienfelde Nord safe?

Wandroz currently rates Marienfelde Nord in Berlin as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Berlin. This rating is derived from Polizei Berlin's official Häufigkeitszahl crime statistic (Kriminalitätsatlas Berlin) — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats. The source data has no day/night breakdown, so this single rating applies at any time of day rather than being a distinct night-specific figure.

Does Marienfelde Nord's rating differ between day and night?

No — Marienfelde Nord's source data has no time-of-day breakdown, so the same rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Berlin) is shown for both day and night rather than Wandroz inventing a separate night figure it doesn't actually have.

Is Marienfelde Nord a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Marienfelde Nord's day rating (relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Berlin) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late.
